_about: Per-interval transition probabilities for the Shako Decision Tree maps. Shako_Sentinel2_Markov.ipynb computes these (pair_probs) but only draws them as a figure, 'Transition probabilities between consecutive dates' (Markov Cell 1, second figure); it never prints them as text. The values below are the 3-decimal annotations in that figure, transcribed cell by cell. The backend checks them on every load: each row must sum to 1 (±0.002), and weighting them by the printed class areas must reproduce the notebook's printed pooled matrix P.
